observations: body L1, L7, L10, L22: «وما» and «معه» (L1), «عليه» (L7), «ما» and the second «على» (L10) and «الأيّام» (L22) are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L1, L2, L4: the parentheses enclose the Arabic runs: «(» stands at the left of the last word of the run of L1 and of L4, «)» at the right of the first word of the run of L2 and of L4.
body L7: «الأوّل» has the hamza on the alif and the shadda on the wāw, no other vowel sign.
body L7, L8: «الموقَّع» has the shadda and the fatḥa in L7 and in «الجدول الموقَّع عليه عرض القمر» (L8); the other two «الموقّع» of L8 have the shadda alone.
body L10: the Latin «(sic)» stands inside the first quotation, after «موقع»; the run is given in reading order with {rtl:}.
body L11: «رؤوس» has the hamza on its first wāw.
body L12, L13, L16: the second figure of «١٢٦» (L12) is a 2 joined to the 6 (5.8 points, as «٢٦» in L16); the last figure of «١٩٢» (L13) is a 2 with one flag, not a 4.

body L4, L9, L12, L13: the 8 of «18-19» (L4) is printed with the top of its upper loop broken; the 6s of «16» (L9, L13) and of «٢٢٣{6}» (L13) have the ball terminal touching the bowl, closing a small upper counter (compare the open 6 of «٢٢٤{6}», L13); the 3 of «٢٢١{3}» (L12) has its lower terminal touching the middle stroke.
body L16, L17: «يَاقُوتٌ» has the dammatan in both lines; in «أَحْمَرُ» (L16) the sukun of the ḥāʾ and the fatḥa of the mīm are printed as one joined sign.

body L5, L20, L22: «9–10» (L5), «٧٣–٧٥» (L20, L22) and «61–64» (L22) are printed with en dashes (5.3-5.6 points). The dash before «اليَوْمُ الأَوْسَطُ» (L20) is 7.8 points long (the other em dashes of the page 9.6-10.3).
body L21, L22: «اليَوْم» (L21) has no vowel sign on the mīm; in «الأَيّام» (L22) the fatḥa of the hamza is printed to its right and the yāʾ has the shadda alone; «بلياليها» is unvowelled.

notes L1: a thin rule 30.3 mm (86 points) long, centred, closes the glossary 114 points below the footnote. A dot (2.4 by 2.3 points) printed between the footnote and that rule, 33 points above it, is not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
